name: Anglo-American University
summary: Private English-language university in central Prague, founded 1990; 7 three-year BA majors with US and Czech accreditation and rolling admission.

ib.text: IB Diploma with at least 24 points and CAS, TOK and EE passed. It waives the English test and is recognised without nostrification; a personal statement and an interview decide.

noDeadline: Rolling admission all year; apply early for autumn 2027

apply.via: AAU application portal or Common App

programmes.name: Psychology
programmes.about: Foundations of psychology and mental health practice, aimed at work in psychological counselling, personal development and well-being; ends with a thesis defence and an oral state exam.
programmes.selectionNote: Rolling: personal statement (250–650 words), CV and transcript, then an interview with the Dean's Office. It filled up for 2026/27, so apply early.

programmes.name: International and European Legal Studies
programmes.about: How international and EU law shape business, diplomacy and society, with internships, small classes and mentoring from international faculty.
programmes.selectionNote: Rolling: personal statement (250–650 words), CV and transcript, then an interview with the Dean's Office; the decision comes a week later.

programmes.name: International Relations
programmes.about: International relations theory, global and domestic politics and philosophy, with an internship and thesis. Take the major or a concentration in Global Security Studies, International Law or Human Rights.
programmes.selectionNote: Rolling: personal statement (250–650 words), CV and transcript, then an interview with the Dean's Office; the decision comes a week later.

programmes.name: Business Administration
programmes.about: Management, marketing, finance, economics and leadership with internships. Take the major or a concentration: marketing and digital communications, entrepreneurship, global management, data analytics, or accounting, finance and ESG.
programmes.selectionNote: Rolling: personal statement (250–650 words), CV and transcript, then an interview with the Dean's Office; the decision comes a week later.

programmes.name: Humanities, Society and Culture
programmes.about: Philosophy, literature, history and the arts and how they shape society, with an internship and thesis. Take the major or a concentration in sociology and leadership, language and culture, or creative writing.
programmes.selectionNote: Rolling: personal statement (250–650 words), CV and transcript, then an interview with the Dean's Office; the decision comes a week later.

programmes.name: Journalism and Media Studies
programmes.about: Journalism combined with media studies, film studies, marketing and public relations, with an internship; a Public Relations and Marketing concentration is offered.
programmes.selectionNote: Rolling: personal statement (250–650 words), CV and transcript, then an interview with the Dean's Office; the decision comes a week later.

programmes.name: Visual Art Studies
programmes.about: Art history, curatorial studies and studio art together, giving a grounding in both the theory and the practice of the visual arts in Prague.
programmes.selectionNote: Rolling: personal statement (250–650 words), CV and transcript, then an interview with the Dean's Office; the decision comes a week later.

notes: Fees are set in Czech crowns per semester (EU/EFTA rate CZK 125,489 in 2026/27); AAU expects a 5% rise for new students, so check the price for 2027 entry.
The IB Diploma is on AAU's list of diplomas recognised automatically under Czech law; bring certified copies of your diploma before classes start.
You can start in autumn or spring; the application fee is CZK 1,000 and is not refunded.
